CustomField.description: Timestamp after which this game room is considered expired and its Status set to Expired. Note: DateTime fields cannot be declared as externalId; a standard index is not available without Salesforce Support. Queried by the cleanup scheduled Apex job.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Calculated at room creation as Created_At + Room_TTL_Hours from Quiz_Config__mdt. Rooms past this time are swept by the cleanup job.
CustomField.label: Expires At
